subject: environmental-science

items.q: Does the ozone hole cause global warming?
items.correct: No — they are separate issues that are often confused.
items.misconception: Yes, the ozone hole causes global warming.
items.random_wrong: Carbon dioxide is not a greenhouse gas.
items.why: Greenhouse gases trap heat (warming); ozone depletion is caused by CFCs.

items.q: Is recent climate change mainly natural?
items.correct: No — the rapid recent warming is driven mainly by human emissions.
items.misconception: Yes, humans have no effect on climate.
items.random_wrong: The climate has never changed before.
items.why: Natural cycles exist, but current rapid warming is largely from burning fossil fuels.
